negative_snippets:
Don't believe in paid reviews. I had a booking at Hotel Shine Inn through MMT and reached around 9:00 am. The person at reception asked me for ₹500 for early check-in, which I paid. But the moment I entered the room. The room was extremely dirty, the blanket and bed had unhygienic stains, and there were bedbugs crawling around.

I immediately informed the reception that I did not want to stay and requested a refund. However, the staff rudely denied it, saying that the entry had already been made. I did not even stay in the room for 5 minutes, yet I lost ₹500.

This was the worst experience I’ve had with any hotel. Totally unhygienic, unprofessional staff, and a complete waste of money. I would not recommend this place to anyone.
Owner is threatening and abusing.

I stayed at Shine Inn Hotel recently and had a very disappointing experience. The staff showed unprofessional behavior, and the room conditions were unacceptable. The mattress and pillows were unhygienic, and I even found bedbugs in the room. This made my stay extremely uncomfortable and concerning for health and safety. I expected better standards of cleanliness and service from a hotel. I hope the management takes immediate action to improve hygiene and staff professionalism.
